==Trivia==
===General===
*Michael's appearance in the game may be based on [[Tom Sizemore]]'s character Michael Cheritto in the 1995 film ''{{WP|Heat (1995 film)|Heat}}'', as both characters are professional bank robbers who enjoy the action, both are overweight, both bear an Italian surname, both have family and kids.
**A clear reference to the movie ''Heat'' is seen in the mission [[Blitz Play]], where Michael, Trevor, and Franklin attempt to rob an armored truck by ramming into it with a large tow truck. In the movie, Sizemore's character and his crew attempt to steal the armored van under the same circumstances, but a crew member, "Waingro," on whom Trevor is based, messes it up by killing the security guards.
**The way Trevor discovers Michael's survival and whereabouts because of his repeated usage of his trademark quote "You forget a thousand things every day, make sure this is one of them" is similar to the way the police identify Cheritto, who likes to call everyone "Slick."
*Michael's [[Special Ability|special ability]] may have been inspired by the {{WC|maxpayne|Bullet Time}} ability from {{WP|Remedy Entertainment}}'s ''[[Max Payne]]'' series and/or the {{Red Dead|Dead Eye Targeting}} ability from [[Rockstar San Diego]]'s ''{{Red Dead|Red Dead}}'' series.
*Michael also shares many similarities with {{Max Payne|Max Payne}} from the ''Max Payne'' franchise:
**Both have/had a wife and child(ren).
**Both have a drinking problem.
**Both men have similar physical appearances.
**Both are around the same age if Michael was born in 1965.
**Both have very similar abilities.
**Both are/were fugitives of the law.
**Both were used in scandals.
**Both can share the same hairstyles and clothing.
*Michael's false surname "De Santa" is similar to {{Red Dead|Vincente de Santa}}'s real surname from [[Rockstar San Diego]]'s ''[[Red Dead]]'' series. However, these characters and games are not related.
*{{WP|Michael Townley}} is a real person under federal witness protection. He was a former {{WP|Central Intelligence Agency|CIA}} operative who was involved in the 1976 assassination of {{WP|Orlando Letelier}}, a [[Chile]]an ambassador.

===''Grand Theft Auto V''===
*In the [[Rush Casting Call]] from 2010, Michael was called Albert De Silva.
*Michael was the first [[protagonist]] that came to Rockstar's mind when they began the development of {{V}}.
*His favorite radio stations are [[Los Santos Rock Radio]], [[Vinewood Boulevard Radio]], and [[Radio Mirror Park]]. He also seems to have a taste for {{WP|funk}}, as the radio inside his [[De Santa Residence|mansion]] is tuned to [[The Lowdown 91.1]], and he will bob his head in appreciation to both it and [[Space 103.2]] while in a vehicle. Additionally, he will listen to [[Rebel Radio]] between [[Did Somebody Say Yoga?]] and [[Monkey Business]], but this might be because this is default for the [[Premier]], his temporary car.
**Furthermore, he calls Trevor's music taste "weird" in [[Paleto Score Setup]], suggesting he may not be fond of [[Channel X]], Trevor's favourite.
*After firing a [[Pistol]] and starting to run or walk, Michael will be holding it in both hands, unlike [[Franklin Clinton|Franklin]] and [[Trevor Philips|Trevor]].
*Michael's great shooting accuracy makes him one of the most challenging opponents while playing [[darts]].
*The quote that Michael uses in [[Prologue (GTA V)|Prologue]] and [[The Jewel Store Job]], ''"You forget a thousand things every day, make sure this is one of them."'', is from the [[Solomon Richards]] movie ''[[Arthur Penny's Sanitorium]]'', although slightly modified. The original line is ''"We forget a thousand things every day, can't we just make this one of them?"''.
*Throughout the game, Michael displays a contempt for [[yoga]] instructors. Coincidentally, his voice and motion capture performer, [[Ned Luke]], is married to a yoga instructor.
*Opposite to Trevor, who hates [[Los Santos (HD Universe)|Los Santos]], Michael declares many times that he hates the [[Grand Senora Desert]] and implies in [[Monkey Business]] that he wants to never return there.
*It is possible that Michael dreamed of becoming a cop growing up, as suggested by Trevor in [[I Fought the Law...]].
*Michael was called "snowbird" by [[Devin Weston]] and [[Gianni]]. "Snowbird" means someone from the {{WP|Northeastern United States|U.S. Northeast}}, {{WP|Midwestern United States|U.S. Midwest}}, {{WP|Pacific Northwest}}, or [[Canada]] who spends a large portion of winter in warmer locales such as southern {{WP|California}}, southern {{WP|Nevada}}, {{WP|Arizona}}, {{WP|Florida}}, {{WP|Texas}}, {{WP|Georgia}}, the {{WP|Carolinas}}, or elsewhere along the {{WP|Sun Belt}} of the {{WP|Southern United States|southern}} and {{WP|Southwestern United States|southwest}} [[United States of America|United States]], [[Mexico]], and areas of the {{WP|Caribbean}}. The way that snowbird was used by Devin and Gianni towards Michael was a reference to how he moved to Los Santos from [[Ludendorff]].
*Michael may be of [[Ireland|Irish]] descent, as a number of his possible [[Tattoos in GTA V|tattoos]] are Irish-themed, he has green eyes, and his favorite drink is whisky, all of these being common Irish traits. Ned Luke is also part Irish.
*Upon returning to his [[De Santa Residence|house]], one possible line of dialogue for Michael to shout is ''"Daddy's back, bitches!"'', which is a reference to the first line of dialogue in {{IV}}.
*Michael has unique, terrified reactions when he hits a family member with a car.
*If Michael accesses the in-game website PsychicShoutout and speaks with Ms. Tammy, she will reveal that [[Amanda De Santa|Amanda]] has already had sex with the yoga instructor ([[Fabien LaRouche]]), the tennis coach ([[Kyle Chavis]]) and also a fireman, a plumber, a beach lifeguard, a truck driver, a dustman, a [[Carlos (GTA V)|gardener]], as well as a [[Hipsters|hipster]]. Michael angrily replies that they have an open relationship. This is later backed up by [[Tracey De Santa]] in the mission [[Reuniting the Family]] when Michael drives himself, Tracey, and [[Jimmy De Santa]] to [[Isiah Friedlander|Dr. Friedlander]]'s [[Isiah Friedlander's Office|office]].
*When walking, Michael is slightly slower than Franklin or Trevor; this might be due to him being retired and not as active as he used to be. Ned Luke even put on 25 pounds to replicate this.
*When someone talks to Michael on his right side, he shifts his body toward that person. This is because in real life, Ned Luke is deaf in his right ear.
*A person comments under the synopsis of ''[[Rum Runner]]'' on the [[Classicvinewood.com|Classic Vinewood]] in-game website, under the pseudonym 'michaelds', saying "''I wanted to be Eddie Olson when I was a kid. Just without the handicap fetish.''". "michaelds" is most likely a pseudonym for Michael De Santa.
*There is a second comment from 'michaelds' under the synopsis of ''[[The Many Wives of Alfredo Smith]]''. In this one, he comments, "''This is how movies should be. A plot so tangled that you still don't know what's going on even after watching it five times. Not the dumbed down sickly sweet trash [[Vinewood (GTA V)|Vinewood]] pumps out these days.''".
*After Friedlander's optional death in [[Abandonment Issues]] ([[Canon|non-canon]]), it is stated on the radio that Michael's name was "Marky De Santos," a fake name made by Friedlander. [[Ahron Ward]] and the police dispatcher also call Michael "Mr. De Santo" and "Michael De Santo" respectively.
*On the Overview page on the [[Rockstar Games Social Club|Social Club]], Michael's business card strangely says "Michael Townley" instead of "Michael De Santa". It also says "entrepreneur" just like Franklin's.
*Michael sleeps for the shortest time of the three [[protagonist]]s. When saving the game with Michael, the game skips ahead six hours. Franklin sleeps for eight hours, while Trevor sleeps for twelve. While he lives alone after his family moves out, one of his [[Switch Scenes|switch scenes]] shows him waking up screaming and pointing a gun around. He may suffer from nightmares, which could explain his short sleeping time compared to Trevor and Franklin.
*According to a phone call with Friedlander, Michael tried taking behavior medication before the events of the game, but stopped because the dosage was incorrect, causing him to "cry and piss all over himself".
*While wearing the [[Epsilon Robes]], other characters, such as [[Bob Mulét]] and other [[barbers]], may say Kifflom to him in greeting.
*Michael, unlike Trevor, dislikes killing people for no reason. He mentions this in a number of missions, including not killing the tennis coach or [[Lazlow Jones (HD Universe)|Lazlow]]. He only kills people when he feels like he has to, such as killing [[Stretch (character)|Stretch]] for betraying Franklin and [[Lamar Davis|Lamar]] or as an act of self-defense.
